_comment: Copy this file to edge-function-secrets.json (gitignored), fill in real values, then run `pnpm supabase:secrets --apply`. These go to Supabase Vault — NEVER commit the filled-in copy. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the script. The NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_* entries are needed because the payment functions read those exact names and the platform only auto-injects the un-prefixed SUPABASE_* variants; the browser-only values (Stripe publishable key, PayPal client id) still belong in .env + GitHub Actions secrets, not here.
